content: Incremental cache: blake3 content hashing -> SQLite .xray/cache.db (file_hash->deps) + bincode .xray/graph.bin (full graph). lasso crate for string interning (30-50% memory savings).
Function-level data lazy-loads ONLY on user expand in viewport. 100K files at function-level = ~500-800MB; never load all at once. Extract on-demand from .xray/cache.db.

3-crate workspace: xray-core (rlib shared by CLI+WASM), xray-cli (native binary), xray-wasm (cdylib wasm32). Plus web/ (TS+Sigma.js) and grammars/ (.scm files). rust-embed for asset embedding with dev hot reload.
XrayEngine WASM is compute-only (layout, blast radius, search, LOD); Sigma.js v3 handles WebGL rendering. Float32Array positions flow directly to GPU. WASM <500KB gzip, 50K nodes @ 60fps.
Use petgraph::StableGraph (not DiGraph). Stable node indices across removals during incremental re-scan.
Use ignore crate (not walkdir). Built-in .gitignore support, parallel walking, ~200-500ms for 100K files on SSD.
Sugiyama hierarchical is DEFAULT layout. Force-directed is a toggle. Sugiyama on 10K nodes: ~100-500ms in WASM. Shows DAG direction clearly.
